inference.method: 21-session circular block,1000 draws,max-t across52 selected-minus-v1 log-return means

inputs.additional_stocks: Not needed: cases have 15-20 IS years after warmup; broad ETF controls extend to1993.

exclusions.BWX: Issuer listing date is 2007-10-02 but the provider firstTradeDate and first observation are 2007-10-11.
exclusions.XOP: Issuer listing date is 2006-06-23 but the provider firstTradeDate and first observation are 2006-06-22.

policy.basis: Yahoo split/dividend back-adjusted prices; not a reinvestment total-return index
policy.historical_availability: unknown; retrieval time is not historical availability
policy.listing_boundary: Quarantine every source observation before the preferred provider firstTradeDate; when absent, use the first valid preferred observation as an identity floor. Earlier issuer continuity requires independent dated evidence
policy.raw: Reconstructed from source Close and strictly subsequent split ratios; never tape-certified

limitations: USD adjusted-unit research, zero cash yield, retrospective cohort and revised vintages.
No promotion or execution authority; daily decisions and next-open gaps.
